content: Nyquist axial sampling for confocal/Airyscan: maximum z-step formula commonly cited as delta_z = lambda / NA^2 (upper bound); practical oversampling convention is to set z-step to ~2.3x finer than the axial (Z) resolution (FWHM) of the objective, i.e. z_step_nyquist = FWHM_axial / 2.3. Confocal axial FWHM formula (Zeiss/Nikon MicroscopyU): FWHM_axial = 0.88*lambda_em / (n - sqrt(n^2 - NA^2)). For a common high-NA confocal setup (480-520nm excitation, NA 1.3) recommended lateral/axial Nyquist sampling is ~50nm lateral / ~150nm axial.
